market_view: VIX spiking to 30.8 (+16.8% today, +39.6% 5d) with QQQ -2% and XLK -3.3% signals an accelerating risk-off regime with tech leading the breakdown. Defensive rotation into XLV/XLP is real but SPY is only -0.49% — tech selloff is diverging from broad market, which is actually helping the QQQ call spread while pressuring SPY put spread valuations via IV expansion.

SPY 675/665p.reasoning: Mid at $2.02 vs $1.38 entry — currently a 46% loss on the credit, approaching but not yet breaching the 1.5x cut trigger at $2.07 (1.5 * $1.38). SPY at $718.78 keeps the short 675p 6.09% OTM, but VIX at 30.8 is expanding premium against us; one more leg down in SPY puts this at the cut threshold.

SPY 670/660p.reasoning: Mid at $1.82 vs $1.20 entry — 51.7% loss on credit, approaching 1.5x cut trigger at $1.80 (already slightly past). Short 670p is 6.79% OTM with SPY at $718.78, but the mid cost of $1.82 technically breaches the 1.5x threshold of $1.80.

QQQ 690/698c.reasoning: Mid at $0.733 vs $1.28 entry — that is 42.7% profit on max profit ($128), nearly at the 50% target of $0.64; QQQ is down 2% today and down 3.47% over 5 days with the short 690c now 8.1% OTM and moving further away. VIX spike will keep some premium in but the directional move is working hard in our favor and we are one more down day from hitting target.
